Description: Create canonical IDEA_MEMORY.md to preserve all architecture/product ideas.
Acceptance Criteria: IDEA_MEMORY.md exists and is linked in project pack.

Description: Standard packet for app/worker/workflow events with artifact refs, routing hints, cost, quality, and causality.
Acceptance Criteria: Every task/event can emit normalized EventContextPacket.

Description: Every worker/subagent returns structured TaskReport after task execution.
Acceptance Criteria: Task reports stored and rendered in run side panel.

Description: Route event context to dependent tasks, workflows, UI, and main AI only when rules require.
Acceptance Criteria: Events trigger correct dependent tasks without waking main AI unnecessarily.

Description: Create compressed run summary for main AI after issue/rejection/cost/completion triggers.
Acceptance Criteria: Main AI receives reflection packet only on configured triggers.

Description: Enable workers to notify downstream workers using typed events, not freeform chat.
Acceptance Criteria: Image worker can notify scheduler worker through artifact.image.generated event.

Description: Right-side live panel showing jobs, tasks, subworkers, events, artifacts, approvals, issues, and cost.
Acceptance Criteria: User can watch workflow progress without main chat waking.

Description: Notification settings per chat/workflow: approvals, issues, completions, cost warnings, patch suggestions.
Acceptance Criteria: User can configure notification rules per workflow/chat.

Description: Activity feed for all workflow events and important updates.
Acceptance Criteria: Pulse feed shows key events across workflows.

Description: Failure UX card with impact, fallback, recommended actions, retry/patch controls.
Acceptance Criteria: Failures show as issue cards, not raw logs.

Description: Approval UI linked to artifacts and event context.
Acceptance Criteria: User can approve/reject/edit external actions from card.

Description: Render images, markdown, JSON, CSV, scripts, stdout/stderr, reports, and generated assets.
Acceptance Criteria: Artifacts display correctly in run side panel and artifact tab.

Description: Top-bar version selector per chat/workflow with current version and quick rollback.
Acceptance Criteria: User can view active workflow version and revert.

Description: Diff .flow, imports, scripts, permissions, memory, and compiled runtime changes.
Acceptance Criteria: Version diff shown before activation/revert.

Description: Allow user to checkpoint a workflow/chat state before major changes.
Acceptance Criteria: Checkpoint can be created and restored.

Description: Share a version/template/run report with redaction controls.
Acceptance Criteria: Shared link hides secrets and respects ACL.

Description: Create a new workflow from an existing version.
Acceptance Criteria: User can fork without copying connected credentials.

Description: Render .flow into editable cards: triggers, jobs, tasks, permissions, tools, imports, budgets, reflection.
Acceptance Criteria: User can inspect workflow without raw .flow.

Description: Click a task to edit type, worker, input, output, failure policy, approvals, budget, routing.
Acceptance Criteria: Task changes create FlowPatch.

Description: Typed patch system for all workflow/manual/AI edits.
Acceptance Criteria: Patches validate and create new workflow versions.

Description: User says changes in chat; main AI proposes FlowPatch; user applies.
Acceptance Criteria: NL edit becomes validated patch and diff.

Description: Raw .flow view with validation, diff, repair with AI, and dry run.
Acceptance Criteria: Power users can edit .flow safely.

Description: Registry of workers/subagents with capabilities, model, cost, latency, quality, failure rate.
Acceptance Criteria: Runtime can choose worker by task policy.

Description: Track approval rate, edit distance, verifier pass rate, cost, latency, failure rate.
Acceptance Criteria: Metrics available for routing and analytics.

Description: Support static, cost-optimized, quality-optimized, and fallback routing.
Acceptance Criteria: Runtime chooses workers within .flow policy.

Description: Execute without waking main AI except user asks or critical failures.
Acceptance Criteria: Low-cost mode works.

Description: Default mode: main AI receives reflection packets on configured triggers.
Acceptance Criteria: Main AI patches only when needed.

Description: Premium/debug mode where main AI can participate during run.
Acceptance Criteria: Can enable per run with cost warning.

Description: Share read-only run summary, artifacts, and issue cards with permission controls.
Acceptance Criteria: Shared run link works without exposing secrets.

Description: Private/team library of saved flows/templates.
Acceptance Criteria: Team members can reuse approved workflows.

Description: In-app, email, Slack, SMS later, webhook later.
Acceptance Criteria: Per-chat notification routing works.

Description: Escalate unresolved approvals/issues after timeout.
Acceptance Criteria: Escalation rules trigger correctly.

Description: Daily/weekly digest per chat/workflow.
Acceptance Criteria: Digest summarizes runs and issues.

Description: Future worker for calls/text-to-voice workflows.
Acceptance Criteria: Research/build after core platform works.

Description: API/webhooks for external systems to start workflows or emit event context.
Acceptance Criteria: External apps can trigger workflows safely.

Description: Internal Event Context Protocol for apps-to-workflows and worker-to-worker context packets.
Acceptance Criteria: Internal protocol docs and SDK exist.
